how: 1) Diagnose: compare ffprobe sum of piece durations with joined duration. 2) Cause: copy-mode concat keeps each encoder's start/end padding and header frame (about 50 ms per join). 3) Frame-count arithmetic is still off, so do not rely on it. 4) Re-encode once at the end (or decode to PCM, concat, encode) so offsets are exact. 5) Verify by measuring the final file and checking last-chapter offset, never assume.

name_ar: نموذج الشيدر في React Three Fiber
name_en: GLSL shader mental model in React Three Fiber
what: يشرح كيف تتكوّن المادة المخصصة من شيدر رؤوس وشيدر بكسلات، وكيف تمر البيانات عبر uniforms وvaryings. — Explains how a custom material is a vertex plus fragment program and how data flows through uniforms and varyings.
when: شيدر، GLSL، تأثير ثلاثي الأبعاد على الويب / shader, GLSL, R3F custom material
how: 1) Mesh = geometry + material; a shader material replaces the material with two GPU programs: the vertex shader writes gl_Position per vertex, the fragment shader writes the colour per pixel. 2) Uniforms carry JS values (time, mouse, textures) identical for all vertices; memoize the uniforms object and update values in useFrame. 3) Varyings pass data (uv, normals) from vertex to fragment. 4) Attributes are per-vertex data available only in the vertex stage. 5) Build effects from noise (Perlin, simplex, curl, FBM), SDFs and render targets for multi-pass work.

name_ar: انتقالات العرض في React حسب ما تعنيه الحركة
name_en: React View Transitions chosen by meaning
what: يختار نوع الانتقال بين الصفحات والعناصر حسب ما يريد أن يقوله للمستخدم: نفس العنصر، بيانات وصلت، ترتيب جديد… — Chooses page and element transitions by what they tell the user: same thing deeper, data arrived, new arrangement...
when: انتقال بين الصفحات، أنيميشن تنقل، view transition / view transitions, page transition, shared element

name_ar: تشخيص FFmpeg: إطار متغير، HLS متعدد الدقات، فحص التيار
name_en: FFmpeg diagnostics: VFR fix, aligned ABR HLS, stream health
what: يشخّص انزياح الصوت والصورة وأخطاء الطوابع الزمنية، ويبني بث HLS بعدة دقات بإطارات مفتاحية متوافقة. — Diagnoses A/V drift and timestamp errors and builds multi-rendition HLS with aligned keyframes.
when: الصوت غير متزامن، تحويل فيديو، بث HLS / audio drift, VFR video, HLS ladder, ffprobe
how: 1) Inspect first: ffprobe -show_streams -of json; look for variable frame rate (screen and phone recordings), odd PTS/DTS, missing audio. 2) VFR drift: force constant frame rate (-vsync cfr / fps filter) before editing. 3) 'Non-monotonous DTS': remux with regenerated timestamps (-fflags +genpts). 4) ABR ladder: H.264 as the reach floor plus HEVC/AV1 for efficiency; renditions 1080/720/480 with identical GOP (-g 60 -keyint_min 60 -sc_threshold 0) so segments align. 5) 'Unknown encoder h264_nvenc' means the build or driver lacks NVENC; fall back to libx264.

name_ar: قص بلا فقد على الإطارات المفتاحية
name_en: Lossless keyframe-aligned cutting and smart cut
what: يقص الفيديو بنسخ التيار دون إعادة ترميز، ويتجنب الشاشة السوداء بالقص على إطارات I أو بإعادة ترميز الجزء الصغير فقط. — Cuts video by stream copy without re-encoding, avoiding black starts by cutting on I-frames or re-encoding only the partial GOP.
when: قص فيديو بدون فقد جودة، شاشة سوداء بعد القص / lossless cut, keyframe cut, black frames after trim
how: 1) Black or frozen first seconds = the cut started on a P/B frame; snap the in-point to the previous keyframe or use smart cut (re-encode only from the chosen frame to the next I-frame). 2) Audio plays but video freezes after export: set avoid_negative_ts make_zero. 3) Keep secondary audio, subtitles and chapters by mapping all streams (-map 0). 4) Generate cut lists with millisecond segments as project files so the edit is reproducible.

name_ar: تغليف الفيديو: عنوان ونص مصغّرة لا يتكرران
name_en: Video packaging: title and thumbnail text that never overlap
what: يكتب عنوان الفيديو ونص الصورة المصغرة كزوج: العنوان يحمل الموضوع والكلمات المفتاحية، والمصغرة تحمل التوتر. — Writes title and thumbnail text as a pair: the title carries topic and keywords, the thumbnail carries the tension.
when: عنوان يوتيوب، صورة مصغرة، ثمبنيل / YouTube title, thumbnail text, video packaging
how: 1) Tag intent: search (front-load the query phrase), browse (more intrigue, the thumbnail breaks the pattern), or both (package for search, thumbnail does browse). 2) Reject any pair where a thumbnail word repeats in the title. 3) Title ≤60 characters where possible; thumbnail text 1-3 words (4 is a caption). 4) Clarity beats curiosity; never promise more than the video delivers. 5) Thumbnail: one accent colour, high contrast, a real face with a readable expression when the format calls for it, nothing that does not earn its place. 6) Always give at least three pairs or three fixes.
